title: Still we covered 6 laureates and taught 100s of teachers to engage in multimodal writing through their love of poetry. Should do it one more time @wio
summary: Still we covered 6 laureates and taught 100s of teachers to engage in multimodal writing through their love of poetry. Should do it one more time @wiobyrne @dogtrax so we can write the @ncte book Seven Strategies to Celebrate Laureates and Master Digital Poetry
author: Greg McVerry
